evidence: codebase/applications/DeepSpeed-Chat/dschat/utils/model/model_utils.py imports HfDeepSpeedConfig from transformers.deepspeed. With transformers==5.14.1, running the repro script raises ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'transformers.deepspeed'.
steps: Create a Python 3.12 virtual environment and install requirements.txt.
Run bash run_repro.sh from the standardized folder root.
